user.title: Connect to Microsoft Foundry
user.description: Enter an Azure OpenAI v1 base URL, API key, and deployment name. Saving performs one small Responses API request to validate the settings.

data_description.endpoint: For example https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1/. A full URL ending in /responses is also accepted.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Microsoft Foundry credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a valid key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Microsoft Foundry
reconfigure.description: Update the endpoint and API key. Saving validates the current deployment.

init.title: Microsoft Foundry conversation options
init.description: Model-specific parameters are only sent when configured. Home Assistant control uses the built-in Assist LLM API and only exposed entities.

data_description.prompt: Replaces the default Home Assistant assistant prompt. Assist API tool instructions are still appended.
data_description.temperature: Clear this field to omit temperature. It is also omitted when reasoning is active.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Disabled omits the reasoning parameter entirely.
